meta.name: understand-onboard
meta.description: Use when you need to generate an onboarding guide for new team members joining a project

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 为新成员生成项目入职指南
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果团队需要快速帮助新成员了解项目
copy.tagline_en: Generate onboarding guides for new team members
copy.fit_line_en: For you if your team needs to quickly help new members understand the project

howto.what: 读取项目知识图谱,生成Markdown格式的入职指南,包含项目概述、架构层、关键概念、导览、文件映射与复杂度热点,并建议保存到docs/ONBOARDING.md。
howto.when: 当需要为加入项目的新成员生成入职指南时触发。若知识图谱不存在,会先提示运行/understand。

say.text: 为这个项目生成一份新成员入职指南。
say.note: Claude会读取知识图谱并输出指南。

say.text: 生成入职指南后,保存到docs/ONBOARDING.md。
say.note: 也可等Claude询问后再确认保存。

say.text: 在入职指南里标出复杂度最高的几个文件。
say.note: 指南本身包含复杂度热点章节。

howto.what_en: Reads the project's knowledge graph and produces a Markdown onboarding guide covering project overview, architecture layers, key concepts, guided tour, file map, and complexity hotspots, and suggests saving it to docs/ONBOARDING.md.
howto.when_en: Triggered when an onboarding guide is needed for new team members joining a project. If the knowledge graph is missing, it prompts the user to run /understand first.

say_en.text: Generate an onboarding guide for new members of this project.
say_en.note: Claude reads the knowledge graph and outputs the guide.

say_en.text: Generate an onboarding guide and save it to docs/ONBOARDING.md.
say_en.note: You can also confirm saving when Claude asks.

say_en.text: Highlight the files with the highest complexity in the guide.
say_en.note: The guide includes a complexity hotspots section.
